text: bno055_imu publishes /imu/data at 25 Hz instead of 50 Hz, with every IMU consumer checked and its staleness limits pinned by tests.

swerve_drive_controller, laser_filter, marker_detector, filter_node and the feetech bridges (lerobot_follower, base_servos) run the rclpy EventsExecutor on the client behind a per-node executor: events|single_threaded config switch; not mcp_server or web_ui.
head_camera_cpp runs at 15 fps (frame_duration_us 66666) on the client, with every consumer checked for rate assumptions.
marker_detector subscribes the head image and camera_info raw and deserializes them only in its process timer.
filter_node uses /follower/joint_states/throttled while idle and the full-rate feedback while a source is actively commanding.
mcp_server subscribes /imu/data and /head/joint_states raw and deserializes them only on the monitor tick or on read.
costmap_zones publishes only the masks that changed, and the local-costmap 'failed to get costmap frame (odom)' cause is found and fixed when it is in costmap_zones' mask or info messages.
The client's Alloy scrapes every 15 s instead of 5 s, with Grafana rate windows below 4x the new interval widened.

A final runbook (deploy through scripts/deploy-nodes.sh, per-service CPU 30 min before and after, nav2 stays active 30 min, head camera stale counter flat, EKF ~30 Hz) that the orchestrator executes after merge.
